result.keywords: This study examines innovation-oriented teaching platforms through a data-mining and stochastic evolutionary game framework. A simulation model is built to analyze how subsidies, platform incentives, and participant strategies interact in educational innovation environments. The results identify a stable incentive threshold for improving platform adoption and teaching effectiveness, and provide policy implications for education administrators and developers.
result.title: Data-Driven Innovation Strategy Simulation in Educational Platforms Using Stochastic Evolutionary Games
